t: Totality Training is a workout tracker for people who train on their own. You follow a programme, log every set, and the app adjusts your weights and your sets from how you actually trained. It runs in your web browser at totality-training.vercel.app , on a phone or a computer. The iPhone and Android apps were sent to Apple and Google for review on 21 November 2026. Your account is the same everywhere, and it is the same login as Totality and Totality Nutrition. Home, with today's workout and Tali's note about a weight going up

The plans # Free A$0. Unlimited workout logging, the full exercise library with demos, 3 of your own routines, the Strength Foundations programme, 3 questions for Tali a day and Sleep sounds. Training A$8.99 a month or A$91.70 a year. All 99 Totality programmes, unlimited routines, weights that go up by themselves when you earn it, sets that adjust to how each muscle feels, Progress (strength charts, personal bests and body stats) and the weekly review. Training + AI A$11.99 a month or A$122.30 a year. Everything in Training, plus Tali builds programmes around your week and kit, gives her take after each workout and writes up your week. 100 Tali credits a month. Every new account starts with a 7 day free trial Trial of everything in Training + AI. No card is needed. When it ends you move to Free unless you pick a plan, and nothing you logged is deleted. See Plans and billing .

Get going in five minutes # Open totality-training.vercel.app and tap Start free . Enter your first name, email and a password. See Create your account . Answer four quick questions: your goal, how long you have been lifting, your week and where you train. Check the programme it matched for you and tap Start this programme . On Home, tap Start workout when it is a training day. See Doing a workout . After your workout, answer How did that feel? so next week's sets fit. See After a workout . Tali says G'day, I'm Tali. Log every set, even the ugly ones. The more honest your numbers, the better I can move your weights for you.

Where things live # The bar along the bottom has five buttons: Button What it is Home (house) Today's workout, this week, today's food from Totality Nutrition and Quick access. See Home Train (list) Your programme, the templates, Tali's builder, your routines and My programmes. See Choose a programme Tali (her face, in the middle) Chat with Tali about your training. See Tali Progress (chart) Strength charts, body weight, measurements and photos Training . See Progress and history Exercise library (book) Every exercise with demos and cues. See Exercise library Settings opens from the gear at the top of Home. The purple ? button on most screens lets you report a problem.

Questions # Is Totality Training really free? Yes. The Free plan is A$0 with no time limit. You keep unlimited logging, the exercise library, 3 routines, the Strength Foundations programme and 3 questions for Tali a day. Do I need a card for the trial? No. The 7 day trial needs no card. If you don't pick a plan, you move to Free when it ends. I already use Totality Nutrition. Do I need a new account? No. Log in with your Nutrition email and password. Your weight, measurements and photos come with you, and paying for Nutrition makes Training 40% off. See With Totality Nutrition . Can I use it on my computer? Yes. Open totality-training.vercel.app in any browser and log in.

t: Signing up takes about a minute. Four questions pick a programme that fits your goal, your level, your week and your kit. The first screen Create your account

Sign up # Tap Start free . Enter your first name, your email and a password of at least 8 characters. Tick the box to agree to the terms and privacy policy, then tap Create account . Already use Totality or Totality Nutrition? Tap Log in instead and use the same email and password. If you sign up with an email that already has an account, the app tells you to log in.

The four questions # Question 1, your goal Question 3, your week What's your main goal? Build muscle, Get stronger, Lose fat or Get fitter. How long have you been lifting? New to it, Under a year, 1 to 3 years, or 3 years or more. This sets the level. What does your week look like? Days a week (2 to 6), time per session (30, 45, 60 or 75 min +) and the days you usually train. Pick as many days as you train, or the app spreads them out for you. Where do you train? Full gym, Home with dumbbells, No equipment or A mix. Programmes only use what you have.

Your programme is ready # The matched programme and the start of the trial The last screen shows the programme matched to you, with its workouts. Your 7 day free trial starts here. If you have Totality Nutrition on the same account, you can choose to show today's food on your Training Home screen. Tap Start this programme to put it on your week straight away. Tap Look around first to skip it. You can pick a programme later from Train . You can change any of these answers later in Settings , Your goal and week .

Questions # I forgot my password. On the log in screen, enter your email and tap Forgot password? . A link to set a new one is sent to that email. Does picking a programme here lock me in? No. You can switch to any other programme from Train at any time. Your history and personal bests are kept.

t: Home is where you start each day. It shows what to do today and how the week is going. The top of Home Further down: this week, today's food and Quick access

What is on Home # The greeting and the gear. The gear at the top right opens Settings . Share my day makes a picture of your day to share. Edit layout lets you move or hide the cards. The trial banner shows how many days of your free trial are left. Tap Plans to see the plans. Tali's note. One line from Tali about today: a weight that goes up, a rest day, or what is left this week. It costs no credits. Today's workout. The programme, the week you are on and today's workout. Tap Start workout . On a rest day it shows the next workout, and you can do it today instead. This week. A dot for each day: filled red when done, a red ring when a workout is still to come. Below it: workouts done this week, your week streak and how much you lifted compared with last week. Today's food. Shown when you use Totality Nutrition on the same account: protein and calories against your targets. See With Totality Nutrition . Quick access. Workout history , Weekly review and Sleep sounds .

t: When a lift stalls or a workout keeps getting missed # Tali's note when a lift has stalled If the same weight has not moved for four workouts, Tali's note on Home says so and tells you the new rep target. If the same workout has been missed three weeks running, she suggests moving your training days or picking a programme that fits your week. See How your weights and sets adjust .

Questions # I do not see Today's food. It shows when your account also uses Totality Nutrition and Today's food is switched on in Settings , Totality Nutrition . Can I train on a different day than planned? Yes. Tap the workout on Train and start it any day. On a rest day, Home offers to do the next workout today instead.

t: The Train tab shows the programme you are on and every way to change it. Train, with your programme and Choose from a template

Choose from a template # Four quick questions The templates that fit On Train , tap Choose from a template . Answer the four questions: Where do you train? , How many days a week? , What do you want to focus on? and How long have you been lifting? . They start on your onboarding answers. The list shows every template that fits, with its days, weeks, level, time and workouts. Tap a template to see every workout and exercise. Tap Start this programme (or Switch to this programme if you are on one already). The focuses are Whole body, Glutes and legs, Glutes and arms, Strength, and Lean and fit. Only the ones with a template for your kit and days are shown.

What a programme looks like # A programme's details Each programme shows its days a week and which days they land on, how many weeks it runs, the level and the kit. Every programme ends with a lighter week. Below are the workouts, day by day, with sets and reps for each exercise. On Free, Strength Foundations is free to start. The others show a lock and need Training .

Questions # What happens to my history if I switch? Nothing. Your workouts and personal bests are kept. The new programme starts from week 1. Can I change a template's exercises? Yes. Once you start it, it is saved under My programmes , and every workout is yours to edit. See My programmes and editing .

t: Everything you start, and every programme Tali builds for you, is saved under My programmes on Train . My programmes on Train One of your programmes

Open one of your programmes # Tap a programme under My programmes , or tap Edit this programme under the one you are on. You can: Rename it. Tap the name or the pencil. Edit a workout. Tap a workout to change it (see below). Start it again. Tap Start this programme on one you are not on. Remove it. Tap Remove from my programmes . Workouts you already did stay in your history.

Edit a workout # Editing a workout Open the programme and tap a workout. Change the name, tap an exercise to change its sets, reps or rest, tap the cross to remove it, or add exercises from the library. Tap Reorder to move exercises up or down. Pair an exercise with the next one to make a superset: do one, then the other, then rest. Save it. You choose Save for this week only or Save for every week from now . Workouts you have already logged are never changed. If you logged this one this week, it stays as it is.

Questions # Will the lighter last week still be lighter? Yes. When you save for every week, the lighter week keeps fewer sets. I removed a programme by mistake. The workouts you logged are still in your history. To use the programme again, start the same template from Choose from a template .

t: A routine is a single workout you can run any time, outside your programme. Free includes 3 routines Free , and paid plans have as many as you like Training . Start from one of these Pick exercises from the library

Make a routine # On Train , under Make your own , tap Build a routine . Give it a name, like Push day or Hotel gym. You can add a note to yourself. Start from Push, Pull, Legs, Full body or At home, or tap Pick my own . To add exercises, search or filter by body part, tap as many as you like, then tap Done . Tap an exercise to change its sets, reps or rest. Use Reorder to move them. Tap Save and start now , or Save for later . Your routines are listed under Your routines on Train . Tap the red play button to start one, or the bin to delete it. Weights go up by themselves on your routines too Training .
Questions # I have hit the 3 routine limit. Delete one you no longer use, or move to a paid plan for unlimited routines.

t: Tap Start workout on Home, or tap a workout on Train . The workout screen has everything you need between sets. Logging sets The last exercise and the finish button

Log your sets # Each exercise shows its sets, target reps, a suggested weight and the rest time. The weight is filled in from last time, and when a weight has gone up it is already filled in for you Training . Do the warm-up sets marked W1 and W2 first. They don't count toward your sets. Do a set, check the weight and enter the reps you did. Add how hard it was as RPE if you like (0 to 10, where 10 is nothing left). Tap the tick to mark the set done. Tap Skip for a set you did not do. Tap Add set for an extra set. When every set is done, tap the finish button at the bottom to save the workout. The bar at the top shows how many sets are done. Tap Workout Overview to see every exercise in the workout, with its sets.

The buttons on each exercise # How to: cues, muscles and the demo Swap an exercise How to shows the muscles worked, the equipment, coaching cues, form cues and rep ranges, with a link to the demo video. History shows what you did on this exercise before. Rest starts the rest timer. Swap replaces the exercise with another for this workout only. Your programme is not changed. Tip Log the reps you really did, even when they fall short. Your next weights are worked out from them. See How your weights and sets adjust .

Questions # Can I finish with sets not done? Mark each set done or tap Skip on it first. The app asks you to before it saves. I logged the wrong weight. Fix the number before you finish. After saving, the workout is in Workout history .

t: When you finish, you see how the workout went and what changes next time. The summary Tali's take

The summary # Tali says compares the total you lifted to something you know, like an African elephant. Completion , your average RPE, the total volume and the sets done. Tali's take Training + AI : a short note on the workout and each exercise that changes. Weights that go up or ease back are filled in for next time. Change them if they feel wrong.

How did that feel? # Three taps for each muscle group Next week's sets Training For each muscle group you trained, answer three questions: Sore since last time? Never sore, Healed early, Just in time or Still sore. The pump. Low, Moderate or Great. How hard was it? Easy, Pretty good, Pushed my limits or Too much. The answers start on the ones that change nothing, so only tap what was different. Then tap Set next week's sets . Each muscle gets one set added, kept the same, or one set taken off, and the change goes straight into your programme for the weeks to come. On Training + AI, Tali adds a line about it. See How your weights and sets adjust for the rules.

Questions # Do I have to answer every time? No. If you skip it, your sets stay as they are. Can I undo a set change? Yes. Open the workout under My programmes and change the sets. See My programmes and editing .

t: Training Totality Training changes your programme from what you log. The rules are fixed and the same for everyone, so you can always see why something changed. They run after every workout you save.

p: How your weights and sets adjust
t: Weights # These look at your two most recent workouts on an exercise in the last 4 weeks, at the same top weight, with at least 2 sets. Goes up. You hit the top of the rep range on every set, two workouts running, and did not rate it a maximum effort. Next time the weight goes up by your usual jump, filled in for you. Eases back. At least half your sets were under the bottom of the range, two workouts running. Next time it eases back so every set lands in the range again. Stalled. The same weight for four workouts and your reps have not moved. The rep target changes, for example from 3 sets of 8 to 10 to 2 sets of 10 to 12, and Tali tells you on Home. The jump up is the smallest jump you have made on that exercise before, so it matches your dumbbells or the machine stack. Cardio and timed work never gets a weight change. When it is rated easy twice, the app suggests a little more time instead.

p: How your weights and sets adjust
t: Sets # After each workout you answer How did that feel? for each muscle. See After a workout . One set less when the muscle is still sore, or the workout felt like too much. One more set when the muscle was never sore or healed early, and the workout felt easy, or it felt pretty good with a low pump. No change for anything else. A set is added to the exercise with the fewest sets for that muscle, and taken off the last one that has more than the minimum. An exercise stays between 2 and 6 sets, and no set is added once a muscle has 12 sets in a workout.

t: The book button on the bar opens the exercise library. It is free on every plan. The exercise library One exercise

Find an exercise # Search by name, like squat or curl. Tap the three dots next to the search box to filter by muscle group, equipment or goal. Tap an exercise to see its demo, the muscles targeted, the equipment, a description, the recommended rep ranges and coaching cues. The same details open from How to on the workout screen.
Questions # Can I add an exercise from the library to my workout? Yes, when you edit a workout or build a routine. See My programmes and editing .

t: Workout history # Workout history Personal bests Open Workout history from Quick access on Home. It is free on every plan Free . Sessions lists every workout by date, with sets, volume, time, average RPE and any new personal best. Tap one to see every set. Personal bests lists each exercise with your best estimated one rep max, the set it came from and your heaviest weight. Filter by exercise to find one lift. Log a workout adds a workout you did without the app.

Progress # Strength charts Body weight Training The chart button on the bar opens Progress, with four tabs: Photos. Add front, side and back photos to compare over time. Measures. Body measurements. Weight. Your daily weight and a 7 day trend. Tap Log Weight . Your weight is shared with Totality Nutrition. Strength. A chart of the estimated one rep max for each lift. On Free, Progress shows what it includes and a See plans button. Progress on Free

Questions # How is the one rep max worked out? It is an estimate from your best set, for example 85 kg for 8 reps. It is a guide, not a test. I log my weight in Totality Nutrition. Do I need to log it here too? No. It is the same weight log in both apps.

t: Tali is the AI coach in Totality Training. She is optional: everything else works without her. Tali can make mistakes and is not a doctor or physio.

Chat with Tali # Chat with Tali on Training + AI On Free: 3 questions a day Tap Tali's face in the middle of the bar. She can see your goal, your programme and your recent workouts, so ask about technique, a plateau, warming up, recovery or planning your week. Tap a suggested question or type your own. Free 3 questions a day. Training + AI 1 credit a question, from 100 credits a month. They top up at the start of each month.

Have Tali build a programme # Build with Tali Training + AI On Train , under Make your own , tap Have Tali build one . Check your goal, days a week, minutes a session and where you train. Under Anything else , tell her about an injury, a target lift or what you want more of. Tap Build my programme . It uses 5 of your Tali credits. Read her draft. Tap Use this programme , or add a note and build it again. Nothing changes until you say yes. Her programme is saved under My programmes , marked Built by Tali , and you can edit it like any other.

Weekly review # Open Weekly review from Quick access on Home. Training shows your workouts this week, personal bests, and the weight and set changes. Training + AI adds Tali's write-up: what went well and one thing to focus on next.

Tali and your data # Tali and your data The first time Tali needs your training data, she asks for your yes. To build programmes and write her replies, Totality Training sends your first name, goal, level, training days, equipment, the workouts you log, what you type to her and, if Totality Nutrition is switched on, your daily protein and calories to Anthropic, the company that makes the Claude model Tali runs on. Anthropic does not use it to train its models. Your email and payment details are never sent. Turn Tali off any time in Settings , Tali and your data .

Questions # I ran out of credits. They top up at the start of next month. On the free trial, the trial credits are used first. Can Tali see my food? Only your daily protein and calories, and only if Totality Nutrition is switched on in Training.
Totality Training and Totality Nutrition use the same account. Log in to both with the same email and they line up. Settings, Totality Nutrition

What is shared # Nutrition in Training: today's food on Home (calories and protein against your targets), and your weekly protein in the weekly review. Training in Nutrition: the day's workout shows on Totality Nutrition's home screen. The same in both: body weight, measurements and progress photos. Log them in either app. Open Settings , Totality Nutrition to turn any of these off.

40% off when you have both # Plans when you pay for Nutrition Pay for Totality Nutrition and every Training plan is 40% off: A$5.39 a month, or A$7.19 with AI. Pay for Totality Training and Nutrition is 40% off when you join on the web or Android. So both apps together are A$14.38 a month. The 40% off does not combine with the welcome offer of 50% off your first 2 months.
Questions # Do I need two accounts? No. One email and password works in Totality, Totality Nutrition and Totality Training.
